instruction: In SolveSpace, import seed_ss_gui_15_gusset.dxf from /home/user/Desktop using the GUI DXF import workflow (File > Import), then continue editing that imported drawing rather than starting from an empty document. Do not use File > Open or launch the DXF as a native SolveSpace file. Use the triangular outline and hole-location guides in the file to create the final right-triangular gusset plate with vertices (0,0), (120,0), and (0,90). Place three diameter 8 holes inset 12 along the three sides, with each hole 12 from its adjacent two edges. Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. When the geometry is complete, align the view to the active workplane if needed, then use File > Export 2d View, choose the DXF file type, and save the result as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_15.dxf. Do not use File > Save As for this final DXF export. You must complete all modeling and editing operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files, shell commands, Python, ezdxf, raw DXF/text/file writes, or helper code to create or edit the final DXF is strictly prohibited.
